name: Thomas Tuchel

spellsCounted.reason: DFB-Pokal 2017, 4-1-4-1 positional play and 3-4-3 experiments, strong Spielverlagerung coverage; start date is the standard 1 July 2015 handover from Klopp (not re-verified in a mined page, a source says 'took over following Jurgen Klopp's departure in 2015')

Two Ligue 1 titles and the first Champions League final (2019/20); 4-3-3/4-2-2-2 and back-three variants. Start and end days from memory, month confirmed by Coaches' Voice ('his departure from the French capital in December 2020')
2021 Champions League, 3-4-2-1 with double pivot, strongest tactical coverage. Start day matches the club appointment article date; end day from memory, not confirmed in a mined page

Bundesliga's best-known flexible set-ups at a bigger club, Champions League semi-final 2023/24; Analytics FC and Bundesliga coverage. Club announced on 2024-02-21 that the relationship would end on 2024-06-30 (last match mid-May 2024). Appointment date from Reuters record 28 March 2023 per search summary and Coaches' Voice (March 2023); unverified to the day

Perfect qualifying (8/8), World Cup 2026 semi-final lost 2-1 to Argentina on 2026-07-15; new deal to Euro 2028 after FA backed him. Counted as ongoing; status in November 2026 inferred from July 2026 reports (ITV: 'set to remain'), not seen directly for November

spellsExcluded.reason: Context only: formative 4-3-1-2 pressing side and Bundesliga records, but pre-dates his high-profile signature spells and is treated as an influence; only described via a Mastermind retrospective in this run

scopeNote: Core spells chosen for titles and tactical coverage: Dortmund 2015-17, PSG 2018-20, Chelsea 2021-22 (the 2021 Champions League; 3-4-2-1 with a double pivot, called a 3-2-5 / 3-2 build-up by Analytics FC and a deep 5-3-2 defensively by Bundesliga.com), Bayern 2023-24 and England from 2025. Mainz 2009-14 is context. Long career narrowed to signature spells, so the profile describes his recurring method: positional play built through central midfielders, attack-minded full-backs/wing-backs, rotation of the central players, and system changes by opponent (sometimes at half-time), rather than one formation. Popular labels like 'a 3-4-2-1 manager' are partial: he used 4-3-3 and 4-2-2-2 at PSG and 4-1-4-1 and 3-4-3 at Dortmund, and a 5-3-2 away to Bayern in 2016. Pressing at Chelsea is zonal-with-triggers (wing-backs press wide, nearest centre-back steps out); Dortmund 2015/16 showed man-oriented pressing in midfield per Spielverlagerung. Spell dates for PSG, Chelsea and Bayern start are given to the day from memory; ends/starts that a mined page did not state are flagged in the reasons and openQuestions. Search summaries on England in autumn 2026 did not include November news.
openQuestions: Exact appointment/exit days for PSG (end 2020-12-29?), Chelsea (2021-01-26 start confirmed by URL date; 2022-09-07 end from memory), Dortmund start (2015-07-01) and Bayern start (2023-03-25) were not read in a mined page.
Bayern end date: club announcement 2024-02-21 set 2024-06-30 as contract end; his last match was in May 2024, so the working end may be earlier.

England status in November 2026: July 2026 reports say he stays through Euro 2028 after the Argentina semi-final (contract has World Cup-linked conditions per ITV search summary); no November 2026 source was mined.

Counter-pressing: Bundesliga.com says he 'often does not rely on counter-pressing' (Chelsea/Bayern), while Chelsea's own 2021 piece quotes him on 'very high-quality counter-pressing' and Spielverlagerung describes strong counterpressing at Dortmund 2016/17. Probably phase- and club-dependent.
Chelsea board relationships (Granovskaia/Cech support, Boehly conflict in 2022) and PSG/Leonardo friction were only seen in search summaries, not in a mined page.
Set-piece routines (Anthony Barry at Chelsea, England set-piece coach plans) lack tier A-B analysis in this run.
